description: Implementation of a priority task queue with multiple internal queue types and consumer management, supporting various concurrency policies and priority levels.

classes.name: detail::any_task_consumer
classes.description: Abstract interface for task consumers with try_pop and bulk pop methods.

classes.name: detail::any_task_queue
classes.description: Abstract base class for task queues supporting push, pop, and control operations.

classes.name: detail::any_task_queue_impl
classes.description: Template implementation of any_task_queue for specific concurrency policies.

classes.name: detail::priority_task_queue
classes.description: Main class managing multiple priority queues and providing task scheduling functionalities.

classes.name: detail::priority_task_queue::consumer_type
classes.description: Consumer object for the priority task queue, managing multiple internal consumers.

methods.name: request_stop
methods.description: Requests all queues and the policy to stop processing.

methods.name: push_blocking
methods.description: Pushes a task into the queue with blocking behavior.

methods.name: try_push
methods.description: Attempts to push a task into the queue without blocking.

methods.name: try_pop
methods.description: Attempts to pop a task from the queues starting from the highest priority.

methods.name: try_pop_bulk
methods.description: Attempts to pop multiple tasks into a batch from the queues.

methods.name: pop_blocking
methods.description: Blocking pop of a task with optional timeout.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns total number of tasks across all queues.

methods.name: queue_capacity
methods.description: Returns the capacity of a specific priority queue.

methods.name: create_consumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer object for the priority task queue.
